name: Dornarika
backstory: Child of Dornakus and Darika; raised in Salthos Cruzados on holds court at the square each morning, hears..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Darika.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Dorakus and Darnus now have a child, Doraknus.
Heard that Dornakus and Fenrius now have a child, Dornarius.
Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darinak.
Heard that Dornakus and Doraknus now have a child, Dornaknis.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Birth Of Dorakus
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: works the temple's walls from sunup, matching new stone to old without being told which is which anymore, and carts materials in himself by midday
